newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil rebounds on covering ahead of data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil rebounds on covering ahead of data.

text.p: Malaysian palm oil prices rebounded in early trading after short covering and bargain hunting emerged following recent falls, traders said.
A mixed soyoil futures close overnight did not dampen the market which saw some covering ahead of the release of official April crop data on May 15, they said.
Private forecaster, Ivan Wong is expected to announce his final April export/output/stock estimates later today.
At 0350 GMT July futures contract rose three ringgit to 1,248 ringgit ($495.04) a tonne.
